units.name: Peasant
units.description: Cheapest single body; quick deployment lets it buy a moment for another recruit.

units.name: Militia

units.name: Spearman

spells_and_tactical_items.Description: Drop an explosive blast that clears clustered enemies.
Restore nearby allies and patch the war wagon hull.
Burst a choke point and slow a whole enemy pack.
Arc high damage through priority ranged or support targets.
Ward a lane so allied units absorb less incoming damage.
Raise a temporary stone wall that blocks enemy advance.
Rally all deployed units with a burst of attack and speed.
Shake the ground across a wide area dealing damage and slowing enemies.
Briefly disables one enemy. Ordinary targets resist repeated control; bosses recover sooner.
Bring back the last fallen ally at half health.
Give one ally a small temporary shield pool. One target; does not protect the wagon or grant permanent defense.
Interrupt a marked channel and deal modest direct damage. Poor raw damage; ordinary attacks are not channels.
Push affected enemies a short distance toward their stronghold. No large damage; displacement-resistant enemies move less.
Temporarily prevent special leap, burrow, phase, or charge movement. Normal walking and attacks continue; it is not a full stun.
Briefly soften physical armor and apply a small burn. Less valuable against unarmored targets or magical wards.
After a visible delay, deal strong area damage and leave a brief fire patch. High mana cost; mobile enemies may leave the warning area.
Instantly remove blight, wounds, and burn from a few allies, with a small heal. No cleanse of root, sleep, or hostile terrain; modest healing.
Reduce healing received and ward regeneration for a short window. Low direct damage; does not strip an existing shield or stop the stronghold's repair.
Move one allied troop a short distance along the battle band. No damage; interrupted setup must begin again, and committed melee cannot instantly jump to a new target.
Briefly draw eligible enemies toward a marked center without changing their target allegiance. No lure and no damage by itself; heavy enemies move less.
Consume up to three existing corpse tokens to recover mana. Needs corpses and an initial payment; empty casts are canceled for free.
Prevent hostile use of corpse tokens in the area for a short window. No damage or healing; friendly conversion can still consume those tokens.
Attach a short regeneration effect that follows its recipient. Slow recovery cannot save an ally from immediate lethal burst; wounds reduce it.
Create visible roots that briefly bind a limited number of crossing enemies. Rooted enemies can still attack; ranged threats need another answer.
Strike the primary target and jump to up to three different nearby enemies with falling damage. Weak against one isolated enemy; chain fails across large gaps.
Remove root or movement slow and briefly boost movement with displacement resistance. No attack-damage boost and no cleanse of sleep, blight, or wounds.
Reveal concealed enemies and identify the genuine body among illusions. No direct damage; a short local window rather than global detection.
Deflect a limited number of direct projectiles back toward their origin at reduced damage. Melee, splash, and ground fields bypass the ward.
Remove a limited number of temporary enemy summons or illusions; natural enemies lose one removable ward instead. Cannot delete natural elites, bosses, or hostile structures.
Briefly suppress eligible enemy special abilities and command auras. Enemies keep their ordinary attacks and movement; cast cost is high.
Builds a cheap wooden blocker after a short, interruptible setup. Buys time against rushers; weaker and slower to appear than Stone Barricade.
A ground trap explodes on the first enemy and leaves a short burning patch. Area denial; enemies can destroy the visible mine before triggering it.
A stationary shrine emits a limited number of healing pulses. Sustained recovery; cannot heal the wagon and can be destroyed.
A placed bolt-thrower fires a finite number of ordinary shots. Rear defense; does not attack structures and needs a safe position.
A crate yields small courage packets while allies hold its immediate area. Trades mana for deployment reserve; enemies can break the crate.
The first enemy triggers a short freeze and consumes the trap. Stops a dangerous advance; control resistance applies to elites.
A placed lantern lures eligible nearby enemies briefly. Protects supports or gathers a pack; bosses resist and area damage destroys it.
A small smoke area breaks enemy target locks and conceals moving allies briefly. Enables retreat or setup; attacks reveal allies and hazards still hurt.
A temporary field removes one blight or wound per pulse. Allows healing through plague pressure; does not cleanse the entire battlefield.
A placed cache near the wagon applies a few repair pulses while protected. Emergency repair; never increases maximum wagon health.
A placed rod interrupts one marked enemy channel in its radius, then burns out. Answers a summoner or null cast; must be positioned before completion.
Marks one enemy near the aimed point as a temporary focus target for eligible allies. Prioritizes a healer or commander; never forces units through blockers.
